Name: Stache-free Harvey (OUTDATED)
Author: Laufente
Description:
[size=3]
This mod simply gives Harvey a good shave and gets rid of his mustache.
There's other mods that do this already, but they all make additional changes to Harvey, so I created my own version.

All I wanted was for him to[i] drop the snot mop... to mow the grass grin...  draw the lip curtains... pluck the mouth brow... hand over the bristle batons...  take out the trash stache... [/i]

Thought I'd share it in case others feel the same!

To install it, just replace the Harvey.xnb file in Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits with this one. Remember to make a backup of the old file just in case!
[/size]
[size=3]Edit: I missed a spot that should've been transparent in the headphone sprite, fixed it and all should be well now[/size]
